001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
005
006/**
007 * A node item visitor that prevents infinite recursion when traversing assembly
008 * nodes by detecting and avoiding cycles in the node hierarchy.
009 *
010 * @param <CONTEXT>
011 *          the Java type of the visiting context
012 * @param <RESULT>
013 *          the Java type of the visiting result
014 */
015public abstract class AbstractRecursionPreventingNodeItemVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT>
016    extends AbstractNodeItemVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> {
017
018  @Override
019  public RESULT visitAssembly(IAssemblyNodeItem item, CONTEXT context) {
020    // only walk new records to avoid looping
021    // check if this item's definition is the same as an ancestor's
022    return isDecendant(item, item.getDefinition())
023        ? defaultResult()
024        : super.visitAssembly(item, context);
025  }
026
027  /**
028   * Determines if the provided node is a descendant of the assembly definition.
029   *
030   * @param node
031   *          the node item to test
032   * @param assemblyDefinition
033   *          the assembly definition to determine as an ancestor of the node
034   * @return {@code true} if the assembly definition is the node's ancestor, or
035   *         {@code false} otherwise
036   */
037  protected boolean isDecendant(IAssemblyNodeItem node, IAssemblyDefinition assemblyDefinition) {
038    return node.ancestor()
039        .map(ancestor -> {
040          boolean retval = false;
041          if (ancestor instanceof IAssemblyNodeItem) {
042            IAssemblyDefinition ancestorDef = ((IAssemblyNodeItem) ancestor).getDefinition();
043            retval = ancestorDef.equals(assemblyDefinition);
044          }
045          return retval;
046        }).anyMatch(value -> value);
047  }
048}
